name: Emilie
source:
Leander's co-worker and the woman he has a crush on. 

She is a no-nonsense woman that refuses to be sexually harassed by anyone. However, Emilie is also kind to those who treat her with respect and is generally liked by her co-workers.

Emilie dresses modestly and does not wear skirts. This is for her own self preference and to also not flaunt her voluminous breasts and butt to her female co-workers. Her pendant is noted to be an accessory she always wears due to personal significance to her.  

She seems to be under a bit of stress as of late though.

Leander gets a mysterious call from Emilie, asking him if he wants to play a game. His acceptation of this game is what sends the plot of the visual novel in motion. 



Note: The game's text is constantly using both Emilie and Emelie as the spelling of this character's name. The intention seems to be that her name is Emilie but I have included both spellings for this character's reference. 

[spoiler]This character's name is forcibly changed to Emberlee, and then Emberly Plump, as part of the Bimbofication process. She is also given the slave name Butt Pillow by her 2 lesbian Dominatrixes.[spoiler]

[spoiler]Note: The Sexual slavery Choukyou Variation tag has been used as it is very clear in the storyline that Emilie didn't entirely know what she was getting into when originally dealing with GeeDee. Thus, a lot of the things she has to do are coerced out of her until she is sexually corrupted and starts to enjoy her sex slavery. This consent transition is why the Choukyou Variation tag has been used. Emilie is also forcibly pushed into becoming her Dominatrixes plaything by GeeDee and thus forced into her Bisexuality.[spoiler]
